pose_convention: (Z up, -Y forward); the manifest also gives every value in Roblox axes.
Roblox: position (x, y, z) -> (-x, z, y), so the front is -Z (LookVector). *_angles_roblox_deg
go to CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x), math.rad(y), math.rad(z)); body_cframe_roblox is the
same Body CFrame as CFrame.new(table.unpack(t)), relative to the prop pivot or HumanoidRootPart.

upright.note: Stands on the hind legs. Same parts; Head pitched back to face forward. Accessories keep their offsets.

carried.note: Cradled across the chest, facing the character's left, so the camera behind the player sees the cat side on. Relative to the HumanoidRootPart centre (R15: 3 studs above the floor).
